summary: Remote-controlled PTY shell and local-port tunneling via relay WebSocket
details: The package's `agentlink-client start` bin connects a WebSocket to a configured relay server (default msclaude.ai) and instantiates a node-pty terminal manager that spawns a real interactive shell (`powershell.exe` on Windows, `$SHELL`/`/bin/bash` on Unix). Bytes received on the relay WebSocket are passed to `ptyProcess.write(data)` in dist/terminal.js, giving whoever holds the relay session arbitrary command execution on the installer's host under the invoking user. A companion tunnel handler in dist/tunnel.js accepts `tunnel_request` / `tunnel_ws_open` / `tunnel_ws_message` messages from the relay and forwards them to `http.request({ hostname: '127.0.0.1', port,... })` and `new WebSocket('ws://127.0.0.1:${port}${path}')`, exposing loopback services on the host to the remote relay peer (gated per port by `~/.agentlink/tools/proxy-config.json`). The relay endpoint is caller-configurable but defaults to a hardcoded author-controlled host; anyone controlling that relay controls the shell.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
